workItem: Harden ADR-0104 so every delegated supersession activation is bound to exactly one chat and one predeclared canonical project folder, prohibit cross-project execution under that activation, cap successful ADR-0104 activations at three for the lifetime of the authority, and preserve a non-delegable Human Owner-only merge boundary for every Pull Request.
workItemDE: ADR-0104 so härten, dass jede delegierte Supersession-Aktivierung an genau einen Chat und genau einen vorab festgelegten kanonischen Projektordner gebunden ist, projektübergreifende Ausführung unter dieser Aktivierung verboten bleibt, insgesamt höchstens drei erfolgreiche ADR-0104-Aktivierungen über die Lebensdauer der Authority möglich sind und jeder Pull Request ausschließlich durch den Human Owner gemergt werden muss.

authorityGuard: No new AUTH, CTRL, ADR or ESS identity is created. The existing ADR-0104 stable authority is tightened in-place through its unmerged v1.2 candidate. The session may not transfer between chats or project owners, may not execute foreign-project work, no fourth successful activation is authorized without a new explicit Human Owner authority change, and Pull Request merge execution is never delegated. Every Pull Request must be merged by the Human Owner.
securityGuard: Single-chat/single-project binding, a monotonic lifetime activation quota of three, fail-closed project correlation, preserved provider authentication, technical gates, secret protection, independent assurance, rollback requirements and a mandatory Human Owner merge action reduce delegated blast radius and preserve separation of duties. Expired or revoked successful sessions still consume their activation ordinal; invalid activation attempts do not.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation requires the then-applicable exact-snapshot Human/Owner gate because this chat does not claim inheritance of the earlier unbound v1.1 bootstrap session. Any resulting Pull Request must be merged by the Human Owner; the delegated executor may not merge or enable auto-merge.
